Marta (CSM): Heads-up — Acorn Data onboarding in APAC is hitting throttles during their load tests. They asked for a temporary QPS bump and proxy IP allowlist so the demo run is smooth. Renewal conversation next Wed, want to avoid regressions. Can SRE/networking help?
Ashish (SRE): Can you share the exact IPs, desired QPS, and duration? Also which region endpoints are they targeting?
Marta (CSM): IPs: 203.0.113.45, 203.0.113.46, 198.51.100.22. They want ~5x current QPS (current 200 -> target 1000 QPS) for 72 hours starting 2026-03-24 08:00 UTC. Region: apac-sg-edge primary (they fall back to us-west and see >600ms p95).
Jin (EngPlatform): @Marta we can do allowlist + temporary rate window. Quick clarifying q's: (1) auto-revoke after 72h? (2) do you want strict routing to apac-edge or allow fallback if capacity hits threshold?
Marta (CSM): Auto-revoke yes. Start strict to apac-edge for the demo, but allow fallback if apac capacity >=85% so the app stays up. Please add a note to the renewal doc: "Demo success contingent on APAC perf — mitigated by temp QPS bump & allowlist."
Sam (Support): FWIW metrics from last 24h: apac success 99.6%, median latency ~320ms, p95 ~610ms. If we spike QPS without smarter caching it could increase p95. Recommend setting prefix/KV cache TTL=30m for their test keys during the burst.
Ashish (SRE): Plan: (A) Add the three IPs to global allowlist; (B) Create rate-limit policy `acorn-data-apac-temp-20260324` limit=1000 QPS window=1s; (C) Set expiry=72h + auto-revoke; (D) Configure fallback threshold 85% capacity. I'll also add an audit entry and tag the change for oncall review.
ops-bot: Change queued: ALLOWLIST_ADD acorn-data [203.0.113.45,203.0.113.46,198.51.100.22] by Ashish (SRE). RATE_POLICY_CREATE acorn-data-apac-temp-20260324 limit=1000 window=1s expires=72h auto_revoke=true fallback_threshold=85%
Jin (EngPlatform): After Ashish rolls this, I'll flip the routing entry in the console to prefer apac-edge for their org and add a dashboard tile showing QPS + p95 for the next 7 days. Also will annotate the rollout with canary step (10% -> 50% -> 100%) if we detect tail latency increase.
Marta (CSM): Awesome — I'll lock in the start time with the customer and post final confirmation here. Adding renewal note: "Acorn Data — temporary APAC QPS bump + allowlist applied to ensure demo stability; monitor p95 and auto-revoke scheduled." :thumbsup:
